## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated in both languages where applicable

## Cleanup safety

- [ ] This change does not expand what the app can delete
- [ ] Or: the pull request explains the positive evidence, revalidation and guardrails for every new cleanup target

## Privacy

- [ ] Fixtures, screenshots, logs and commits contain no credentials, session contents, thread IDs, usernames or private local paths
